description:
Two related cleanups:

1. Telemetry convention (per :telemetry docs, Ecto, Phoenix) is that the first segment is the OTP app emitting the event. Our Anthropic events are [:octo_pi_ai, :anthropic, ...] — should be [:octo_pi_ai_anthropic, ...]. Core events stay [:octo_pi_ai, ...]. Downstream consumers can then filter by app prefix.

2. CoreHandler and AnthropicHandler are near-duplicates — @events list + Logger.info formatter. Factor OctoPi.Telemetry.Logger.attach(handler_id, events) in octo_pi_ai. Both apps call it with their event list.

TDD:
- Existing telemetry tests already assert event names — update assertions to new names.
- Existing tests stay green otherwise.
- No new tests needed; this is a rename + factor.

Files: producer.ex, auth.ex, ai.ex (emission sites); core_handler.ex (→ logger helper); anthropic_handler.ex (→ delegates to helper); application.ex files.
title: Telemetry: move Anthropic events under :octo_pi_ai_anthropic + factor Logger helper
